title: FriendlySMP Modded
description: FriendlySMP is a growing Minecraft server built on mutual respect, community-driven fun, and chill vibes for all ages
body:
### Welcome to FriendlySMP!

FriendlySMP runs a family friendly modded server using the Homestead modpack. You can claim some land and build a base using a myriad of new block types, trying out new workbenches and farming new crops. You can even use Create to engineer and automate processes for your base. 

Explore brand new overworld biomes, a better Nether, better End, and even the Otherside through the Ancient City portal! Find new mobs (both friendly and hostile) and new types of villagers! 

We're always happy to welcome new players! If you need any help, please join our discord and ask for help! 

Common issues:
> - Mismatched Mods: Add this mod to your modpack in modrinth (fabric, 1.20.1)
> [ftbfiltersystem](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-filter-system) 

> - Crashing on startup or lagging
> Go to your modpack and click the settings/gear icon, then Java & Memory.
> Increase memory allocated (Recommended: 6gb, No more than 10gb)
